newsitem.title: THAILAND: Charoen Pokphand to invest in insurance.
newsitem.headline: Charoen Pokphand to invest in insurance.

text.p: Charoen Pokphand Feedmill Plc said on Wednesday it would participate in an investment in Charoen Pokphand Life Insurance Co Ltd which is to be set up after receiving a cabinet approval last month.

Charoen Pokphand Feedmill, a subsidiary of Thailand's major conglomerate Charoen Pokphand Group, said in a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand (SET) that it would buy 18 percent out of the 50 million ordinary shares at 10 baht par.
Charoen Pokphand Life Insurance, also a unit of Charoen Pokphand Group, won one of the 28 new licences for life and non-life insurance approved by the cabinet on March 25.
Charoen Pokphand Feedmill was trading at 73 baht, up 0.5, at 0443 GMT.
